commit.message:
update artifact README and scripts (#9)

This commit revises the artifact to adhere to the CAV 2026 artifact guidelines (see). The README is refactored to be more in line with the provided template.

It also resolves issues in the evaluation scripts. Most importantly, it fixes a condition that would lead to the smoke tests not having their timeout applied. 

Additionally, it adds a check for correct permissions on the mounted local storage and a set of smoke tests for the ByMC image.
